cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description:
The ultimate small group sailing experience!


A step up from our 270, the Catalina 320 continues the ultimate in sailing comfort and modern amenities, with a larger passenger capacity.
what_is_included: Vessel includes a full cabin with berth and dinette areas, galley and head. Large cockpit and stanchion mount seating make this sailboat comfortable for up to ten people.
what_to_bring: Photo ID and credit card used for payment required for check in. Captain's fee is $50/hour + gratuity, paid directly to captain in cash
disclaimers: Equivalent sailing experience required. A sailing resume will need to be completed at least 48 hours prior to rental for new customers.
